info.name: CreatorConnect - Profile Service
info.description:
Profile Service CRUD APIs.

Base URL: http://localhost:8082 (direct) or http://localhost:8080 (via API Gateway — same paths).

Setup:
1. Register + login via the Auth Service to obtain a JWT.
2. Paste the token into the collection variable `jwtToken` (or use the Swagger/Postman Bearer auth tab).
3. Fill the collection variable `userId` with the userId from the login/register response — it is the UUID that identifies your profile.

Endpoints:
- POST   /profile           Create profile (userId taken from JWT)
- GET    /profile/me        Get my profile
- GET    /profile/{userId}  Get profile by userId
- PUT    /profile/{userId}  Update profile (owner only)
- DELETE /profile/{userId}  Delete profile (owner only)

request.description: Creates a profile for the authenticated user. The owning userId is read from the JWT — never from the body. Returns 409 if the user already has a profile.
Returns the profile of the authenticated user. Returns 404 when the user has not created a profile yet.
Returns any user's profile by their userId (UUID). Any authenticated user may view any profile.
Partially updates the profile owned by userId. Only the authenticated owner may update it (403 otherwise). Fields omitted from the body are unchanged; send "" for an optional field to clear it.
Deletes the profile owned by userId. Only the authenticated owner may delete it (403 otherwise).
